questions.question: How many days of Casual Leave can an employee take in a month?
questions.ground_truth_answer: Casual Leave can be taken for a maximum of 3 days in a month.

questions.question: How many days of Casual Leave can an employee take, and can Casual Leave be combined with Earned Leave or Sick Leave?
questions.ground_truth_answer: Casual Leave can be taken for a minimum of 0.5 days to a maximum of 3 days. It cannot be appended with Earned/Privileged Leave or Sick Leave.

questions.question: Can Sick Leave (SL) be appended with Earned Leave (EL), and when is a medical certificate required?
questions.ground_truth_answer: Yes, Sick Leave can be appended with Earned Leave. A medical certificate is usually required for absences exceeding 2 or 3 days.
